source.notice: Research library snapshot, not a current installed-mod list. Map/cluster scope is historical and may have changed. Check current Nitrado lists or Rexy provider verification before treating a mod as installed.

entries.name: Additions Ascended: Brachiosaurus
entries.summary: Adds the ARK Additions Brachiosaurus, a rare giant herbivore that can appear in jungle and grassland environments. Its body is heavily protected, its legs are a tactical weak point during encounters, and a tamed Brachiosaurus is designed as a powerful harvesting creature.
features: Rare large herbivore for jungle/grassland regions.
Tough body and legs create a distinct combat/taming encounter.
Tamed Brachiosaurus is a high-capacity resource harvester.
Can switch between gathering and defensive behavior.
Its bellow can frighten dangerous nearby creatures.

entries.name: Alfa Oceanic Platforms
entries.summary: Adds an ocean-building system centered on large platform variants, floating foundations, and triangle foundations for constructing bases over or on the water.
features: Multiple ocean-platform styles, including open, closed, cage, wood, grass, ice, underwater-cage, Shasta-cage, concrete, adobe, and partial variants.
Floating foundations and triangle foundations extend water-building options.
Support distance can be adjusted by server configuration.
A radial option can extend support to nearby foundations.

entries.name: Arkitect Structures Remastered
entries.summary: A large cross-platform building mod that expands ASA construction with custom structure tiers, shapes, roofs, glass, decorative pieces, and specialty foundations.
features: Adds broad thatch, wood, stone, adobe, glass, and decorative building families.
Includes non-vanilla shapes such as steep and curved roof pieces.
Provides ornate and clear/glass-style construction options.
Includes specialty pieces such as AntiGrav foundations and other advanced building components.
Designed as a remastered continuation of Arkitect Structures building content for ASA.

entries.name: Auto Engrams!
entries.summary: Automatically unlocks eligible engrams as a survivor reaches the required level, removing the need to spend engram points manually for normal unlocks.
features: Unlocks engrams automatically when level requirements are reached.
Does not consume engram points for automatic unlocks.
Avoids repeated unlock-screen spam.
Can unlock across DLC restrictions and works with eligible mod engrams regardless of mod order.
Respects hidden engrams, overridden level requirements, and prerequisite engrams.

entries.name: Auto Fishery | Gaia Studios
entries.summary: Adds an automated underwater fishery built around a placeable clam that can generate aquatic resources over time.
features: Produces resources such as Oil, Black Pearls, Silica Pearls, Angler Gel, Leech Blood, and Ammonite-related resources.
Activated and managed through its radial menu.
Can generate aquatic defenders/creatures depending on configuration.
Passive creature generation can be enabled or disabled.

entries.name: Awesome ARK Tools
entries.summary: A broad administration and utility toolkit for ASA with tools for spawning, structure management, creature management, player/tribe inspection, object location, and other server-management workflows.
features: Admin tooling can spawn custom creatures and items.
Can copy/paste or otherwise manage structures and buildings.
Includes creature actions such as tame/claim, level/XP, imprint, color, healing, duplication/baby-related operations, and other management functions.
Includes player/tribe browsing, wild-creature tools, tracking, command/item/dino databases, object location, and file-oriented utilities through the AAT menu.
Some overview functions are available without administrator privileges, while powerful mutation/spawn/destructive operations remain admin-oriented.

entries.name: Awesome Spyglass!
entries.summary: An enhanced spyglass that displays detailed information about the object currently being targeted and provides extensive player/admin display customization.
features: Can target dinos, players, structures, eggs, loot, supply crates, and natural structures.
Displays target-relevant information in the spyglass UI.
Provides many player-customizable display options.
Server admins can disable selected options in-game.
Mod authors can expose custom dino information to the UI through the supported SpyGlass tag convention.

entries.name: Awesome Teleporters!
entries.summary: Adds a network of placeable teleporters, a portable remote teleporter, and a dino-tracking/return tool for rapid travel and creature recovery.
features: Placeable teleporters can travel to friendly or public destinations.
Destinations can use custom names/coordinates and multiple teleport bubble sizes.
Teleporters can be picked up and do not require a foundation.
Supports favorite destinations plus creature/corpse-oriented recovery features depending on configuration.
The Remote Teleporter creates a teleport bubble at the player location and can travel to allowed destinations.

entries.name: Better Breeding
entries.summary: Better Breeding changes inheritance so offspring receive the best available wild-level stat values and mutations from their parents, reducing the RNG involved in combining breeding lines. It does not transfer post-tame levels.
features: Prioritizes the best eligible wild stat levels from the parents.
Can pass useful mutations more consistently while combining breeding lines.
Post-tame levels are intentionally not inherited through this mechanic.

entries.name: Better Variants
entries.summary: A compatibility/spawn-control layer for creature-variant mods that lets multiple replacements or variants coexist instead of one replacement chain suppressing the others.
features: Merges compatible creature replacement/variant pools so multiple variant mods can spawn together.
Supports weighting by creature and by variant/mod source.
Supports blocking specific creatures or source mods from the merged system.
Designed to reduce mod-order conflicts where only one variant would otherwise win a replacement.

entries.name: Breeding Stopper
entries.summary: Breeding Stopper is an operational control that disables unattended breeding, including on server startup and when all members of a tribe go offline. It does not improve stat or mutation inheritance.
features: Can stop breeding automatically at server startup.
Can stop breeding when all members of a tribe go offline.
Can be configured to affect both genders or selected genders.
Designed to prevent unattended breeding load rather than alter baby genetics.

entries.name: Creature Spawns (Pyromane)
entries.summary: Adds Pyromane spawn opportunities to supported maps outside its original content, while still requiring the relevant paid DLC entitlement to tame/use the creature where Wildcard requires it.

entries.name: Crafting Skill Potion
entries.summary: Adds a temporary crafting-build potion that lets a survivor dedicate their stat points to Crafting Skill for a short crafting window and then restores their prior stat setup.
features: Engram is available at level 1 and the potion can be crafted in player inventory.
The documented recipe uses Mejoberries, Narcotics, Rare Flowers, Rare Mushrooms, and Stimulants.
The effect lasts about two minutes by default.
While active, the survivor is reset and points are directed into Crafting Skill; normal stat spending/mindwipe behavior is temporarily restricted.
When the effect expires, the previous stat setup is restored.

entries.name: Custom Dino Levels
entries.summary: Custom Dino Levels changes wild-creature level distribution, allowing servers to favor higher levels, equalize level chances, or mimic distributions such as Ragnarok while still respecting server difficulty.
features: Supports several level-distribution modes including equalized and high-level-weighted distributions.
Can constrain allowed minimum and maximum levels through configuration.
Works with normally spawned vanilla and compatible modded creatures.
Existing creatures are not retroactively changed.

entries.name: Cybers Structures QoL+
entries.summary: A large S+-inspired, fully configurable QoL/building suite with more than 200 structures/recipes, wireless crafting, resource pulling, creature/breeding automation, storage systems, industrial upgrades, tools, and cluster utilities.
features: Wireless Crafting, improved ASA snapping/placement, pull-system resource transfers, and Omni/Multi tools.
Mindwipe support that preserves learned engrams and a way to reset misallocated tame stat points.
Resource conversion/grinding systems including Organic Polymer conversion and rare-resource recipes.
Large automation set including Mutator, Propagator, Vivarium, Hatchery, Nanny, Farmer, Gardener, Item Aggregator, Dedicated Storage tools, and Cryofridge automation.
Cluster/creature tools include a Transmitter with dino scan/tracking, boss-fight access, and cluster transfer.

entries.name: Der Dino Finder
entries.summary: Adds an in-game creature-finding map interface that scans for creatures and lets players filter and track matching dinos.
features: A map button toggles the finder interface.
Filters include species, gender, age, and level.
Can place markers for high-level matching creatures and allow the player to select a marker for tracking.
Includes administrative/summon-oriented recovery behavior when enabled.

entries.name: Dino Color Tokens
entries.summary: Adds craftable color tokens that can be force-fed to tamed creatures to change their color regions.
features: Tokens change creature colors when consumed by the target dino.
Author documentation provides crafting support through high-tier crafting stations and administrative spawn information.
The engram can be disabled through configuration if a server wants admin-only access.

entries.name: Explorer Notes Tracker
entries.summary: Adds a tracker for finding Explorer Notes across maps, with directional guidance to the nearest relevant note.

entries.name: Frankis Garden Deco
entries.summary: A decorative landscaping pack focused on garden scenery such as flowers, bushes, trees, and other plants for base design.
features: Adds placeable decorative flowers, bushes, trees, and plants.
The author maintains a separate blueprint/spawn reference for the decoration set.

entries.name: Greenhouse Glass Fix
entries.summary: Adds clearer visual variants for greenhouse glass structures so players can keep greenhouse building functionality while using more transparent glass appearances.
features: Placed greenhouse pieces can switch visual variants through their interaction wheel.
Includes translucent/clear glass-style variants and supports paint/dye regions.
Designed to be safe to add/remove; removing the mod reverts the special appearance rather than replacing the underlying greenhouse structure.

entries.name: Just wants to cuddle
entries.summary: Simplifies baby imprint requests so babies ask only for cuddles/petting instead of random walks or food requests.
features: Removes walking requests from the normal imprint request pool.
Removes random requested-food imprint tasks.
Keeps the cuddle/petting interaction as the imprint request.

entries.name: JVH Garden Decor
entries.summary: A broad landscaping and garden-decoration pack with plants, planters, paths, bridges, fountains, lights, and themed outdoor pieces.
features: Includes hedges, rose bushes, climbing roses, flowers, potted plants, planters, cherry blossom/wisteria-style vegetation, pathways, bridges, and fountains.
Many pieces expose color/texture variants through radial options.
Includes functional decorative lighting with automatic day/night behavior.
A dedicated crafting station organizes many of the pieces.
Several assets react to environmental conditions such as rain/weather.

entries.name: Kibble Vending Machine
entries.summary: Adds a placeable vending/crafting machine that produces kibble in exchange for raw metal, providing an alternate way to obtain kibble without the normal cooking chain.
features: Unlocks at level 26 for 10 engram points according to the author page.
Uses raw metal as the documented purchase/crafting resource.
Author prices begin at 30 raw metal per kibble and crafting time is reduced.
The structure supports side/front-back snapping and pin locking.

entries.name: Mining Drill (Cross-Platform)
entries.summary: Adds a lightweight mining-drill tool intended for convenient resource gathering with reduced upkeep and resource weight.
features: Unlocks at level 1 for zero engram points according to the author page.
Documented recipe uses Crystal, Metal Ingots, and Polymer.
After initial gasoline activation, the tool is designed for effectively unlimited power.
No overheat and unlimited durability are advertised features.
Provides major carried-resource weight reduction while equipped.

entries.name: Mouse Saver - Easy Dino Attacks
entries.summary: Lets players hold creature attack inputs instead of repeatedly clicking/tapping, reducing input fatigue during repetitive dino attacks.
features: Works with most creatures and the primary attack inputs.
Per-creature behavior can be managed through radial settings.
Servers can blacklist creature classes that should not use the override.

entries.name: Name That Dino! - Automatic Themed Random Dino Names
entries.summary: Automatically assigns themed names to newly tamed creatures and babies using large species-aware name pools.
features: Contains thousands of themed names across many supported creatures.
Uses male, female, and unisex pools where appropriate.
Draw-bag logic reduces immediate repeats.
After a name pool is exhausted, reuse can be distinguished with Roman-numeral suffixes.
Works with normal tames, bred babies, and supported wild-baby tames.

entries.name: Pelayori's Cryo Storage (Crossplay!)
entries.summary: A full cryopod-storage suite with cryopods, cryofridge, Cryogun, Cryo Terminal, and Neuter Gun, designed to preserve creature data and remain compatible with buffs such as Shiny effects.
features: Cryopods and Cryofridge provide creature storage.
Cryogun quickly cryopods creatures.
Cryo Terminal can recharge cryopods, automatically pick up babies, destroy unwanted creatures, and provide additional management actions.
Neuter Gun can neuter or kill targeted creatures on demand.
The author states stored creatures are protected from the restart-deletion problem addressed by the mod.

entries.name: RR-Tranqs and more!
entries.summary: Adds stronger tranquilizer tiers, narcotics, utility potions, and related taming items centered on the RR-Tranq Smithy.
features: The author states the listed items have their own engrams.

entries.name: S-Dino Variants
entries.summary: Adds a large collection of glowing S-variant creatures with modified visuals and, for many species, extra gameplay traits compared with their vanilla counterparts.
features: S variants are intended for use across maps supported by the mod.
Many tamed S creatures share a general stat tradeoff of increased attack/movement with reduced health.
S variants are documented as radiation immune.
Many individual S species have unique extra mechanics beyond the shared baseline.
Special effects can be toggled through the creature interaction menu where supported.

entries.name: Shiny! Dinos Ascended
entries.summary: Periodically spawns rare Shiny versions of existing creatures with distinctive colors and optional enhanced levels/abilities, plus tracking, notification, reward, and display systems.
features: Shinies are special variants of existing species and may have enhanced levels or abilities depending on configuration.
Shinies can be tamed or hunted for configurable rewards.
They remain compatible with their base species for breeding/mate-boost behavior.
Includes a tracker and configurable spawn notifications.
Supports in-game configuration, optional Discord notifications, and a Shiny Display for showcasing stored creatures.

entries.name: Simple Trade
entries.summary: Provides player-to-player and admin trading through trade structures and an optional global market, supporting item and creature listings with configurable currencies.
features: Players can list items or supported creatures and define a price or requested goods.
Transactions can complete through dedicated structures/global-market workflows without players meeting in person.
Supports admin shops and creature sales through compatible cryo systems.
Server admins can configure main/alternate currencies from eligible vanilla or mod items.

entries.name: Solo Farm Mod
entries.summary: Adds a Solo Farm Remote and farm-mode controls that keep compatible farming creatures performing their harvesting attack automatically until configured limits are reached.
features: Solo Farm Remote can place compatible creatures into continuous farming behavior.
Supports remove/keep item lists and reusable presets.
Farmmode Enabler can expose radial farm-mode controls on creatures that normally do not have them.
Supports administrative enabling for otherwise disabled creatures.

entries.name: Stop The Steal - Ascended [UPDATE NOV 2024]
entries.summary: Changes wild Pegomastax and Ichthyornis behavior to greatly reduce nuisance item theft while preserving selected taming/behavior mechanics.
features: Wild Pegomastax no longer steal items from players under normal behavior and are changed to knockout taming.
Tamed Pegomastax can still use their instructed pickpocket behavior.
Healthy wild Ichthyornis are prevented from normally targeting players, tames, or non-water creatures.
Provoked Ichthyornis can still retain a small chance to steal.
Affected newly spawned creatures use the modified behavior.

entries.name: TG Stacking Mod 10000-90
entries.summary: A resource stacking/weight-reduction mod that raises many stack sizes and substantially reduces carried resource weight.
features: Many resources stack up to 10,000.
Ammo and kibble use smaller documented stack caps such as 500.
Resource weight is heavily reduced.
Designed to load high in mod order so its resource replacements take precedence.

entries.name: Upgrade Station
entries.summary: Adds an Upgrade Station system for improving qualifying weapons, armor, and saddles through quality tiers, with complementary salvage/resource-recovery functions.
features: Can upgrade qualifying gear from lower quality through higher tiers, including Ascendant.
Supports weapons, armor, saddles, and many mod/Tek items when they expose a valid upgrade path.
Provides salvage behavior for eligible gear/structures to recover resources.
The ASA port is still treated by the author as an actively developed/work-in-progress system.

entries.name: Utilities Plus
entries.summary: Adds reusable or enhanced versions of common utility items to reduce repetitive crafting and improve exploration convenience.
features: Includes reusable Bola, Flare Gun, and Parachute variants.
Grappling Hook+ still uses a crossbow but the hook is not consumed and is designed to work in many cave contexts.
Includes a reusable Lasso and reinforced Whip.
Items can be individually enabled/disabled through server configuration.

entries.name: Wall'n'Floor Decor
entries.summary: A very large decorative furnishing pack covering creature-themed displays, furniture, lighting, room décor, storage, event pieces, and glass/decorative architecture.
features: Includes 100+ creature statues plus bone heads, eggs/nests, figurines, holograms, and boss-themed displays.
Adds furniture and room-decoration collections.
Includes extensive lighting and wall décor.
Includes event/themed decoration sets and storage pieces.
Provides stained/clear glass and other architectural decoration options.

entries.name: Creature Spawns (Griffins)
entries.summary: Adds Griffin spawns to supported ASA maps/regions so servers can introduce Griffins outside their normal availability.

entries.name: LudopARK CASINO Freemium
entries.summary: A server-economy and casino suite with minigames, player/dino/item shops, multiple currencies, reward systems, and administrator-configured casino structures.
features: Free games include Raptor Race, Blackjack, Slot Machine, Mystery Box, Wheel of Fortune, Piggi Bank, and Poker Bob’s Tales; additional premium games are also offered.
Supports item shops, player shops, dino shops, and item-sell shops as part of a server economy.
Includes Daily Reward, Welcome Kit, and Online Reward structures/workflows.
Supports several built-in coin resources and a Currency Exchange Machine.
Shop sales can be logged and optionally delivered to Discord via webhook configuration.

entries.name: Astraeos - Trireme Ships
entries.summary: Adds a buildable Greek Trireme ship originally created for Astraeos but usable on other maps supported by the server.
features: Adds a Greek Trireme ship.
The ship can be built on by players.
Its sail appearance can be changed.
The author states the ship is not damaged by Leedsichthys.

entries.name: Better Horde Mode [QoL, Open Source]
entries.summary: Improves Extinction-style Orbital Supply Drop and Element Vein horde events with visibility, radar, cleanup, and configurable quality-of-life controls.
features: After a configurable delay, remaining hostile creatures can be marked with a bright beacon so hidden enemies are easier to locate.
Can optionally kill lingering/idle event dinos after a configured time.
Provides a radar UI to help find remaining enemies.
Adjusts event auto-destruction behavior/range and can prevent completed events from disappearing solely because players move farther away.
Compatible with vanilla OSD/Element Vein spawns and supported spawner mods.

entries.name: Base Guardian | Gaia Studios
entries.summary: Adds a place-and-go base-protection structure that automatically eliminates wild dinosaurs entering a configurable protection radius.
features: Automatically removes wild dinosaurs inside its protected area.
Default author-documented radius is ten foundations.
Protection radius can be changed through the mod’s INI option.
Activates automatically when placed.
Baby dinos are intentionally not affected, allowing breeding/raising within the protected area.

entries.name: Paleo ARK Ascension
entries.summary: Prehistoric creature content pack; mechanics and individual server builds are not verified by this listing.
entries.historicScope: Legacy listing observed on all ten submitted Legacy Mods pages

entries.name: Paleo ARK – Evolution | Apex Predators
entries.summary: Distinct Paleo ARK creature project. This listing does not verify runtime creatures, exact commands or enabled builds.
entries.historicScope: Legacy listing observed on all ten submitted Legacy Mods pages

evidenceNote: Two additional mods were observed by the owner in the Legacy Nitrado enabled-mod listings on 2026-10-08; this does not prove live mod loading or availability on the Limited cluster.
